servers.description: An MCP server that provides AI assistants with comprehensive access to n8n workflow automation nodes, properties, and documentation. It enables models like Claude to search for nodes, access configuration templates, and manage workflows through natural language.

MCP_MODE.description: Required for Claude Desktop. Set to 'stdio' to ensure only JSON-RPC messages are sent to stdout, preventing debug logs from interfering with the protocol.

LOG_LEVEL.description: The logging level for the server (e.g., 'error', 'info', 'debug').

N8N_API_KEY.description: Your n8n API key, required for workflow management tools (create, update, execute).

N8N_API_URL.description: The URL of your n8n instance (e.g., https://your-n8n-instance.com or http://host.docker.internal:5678).

N8N_MCP_LLM_MODEL.description: Model name for local LLM integration to enable AI-powered documentation summaries.

N8N_MCP_LLM_BASE_URL.description: Base URL for local LLM integration to enable AI-powered documentation summaries.

WEBHOOK_SECURITY_MODE.description: Set to 'moderate' to allow webhooks to your local n8n instance while still blocking private networks and cloud metadata.

DISABLE_CONSOLE_OUTPUT.description: Set to 'true' to prevent debug logs from interfering with the protocol.

SQLJS_SAVE_INTERVAL_MS.description: Controls how long to wait after database changes before saving to disk when using the sql.js fallback (Default: 5000ms).

N8N_MCP_TELEMETRY_DISABLED.description: Set to 'true' to opt out of anonymous usage statistics.
